# Hierarchies & dimensions

*Describes reflex-silverpoint-react 0.8.0, wrapping silverpoint 0.8.0.*

Each chart's own props, with the JS name the silverpoint MCP tools and the React docs use. The props
every chart shares (`data`, `title`, `height`, `ground`, `palette`, the events…) are in
[SKILL.md](../../SKILL.md#common-chart-props); the defaults and notes of each prop come from the
MCP's `get_chart`. In each example the rows live in a `rx.State` field passed as `data`.

<!-- generated:family -->

**8 charts:** [`waffle_chart`](#waffle_chart) · [`marimekko_chart`](#marimekko_chart) · [`squarified_treemap`](#squarified_treemap) · [`sunburst_chart`](#sunburst_chart) · [`tree_chart`](#tree_chart) · [`parallel_coordinates_chart`](#parallel_coordinates_chart) · [`polar_line_chart`](#polar_line_chart) · [`polar_scatter_chart`](#polar_scatter_chart)

## waffle_chart

`waffle-chart` · `WaffleChart` · A unit grid filled in reading order by category.

Its own props (the common ones are in [SKILL.md](../../SKILL.md#common-chart-props)):

| Python | JS | Type |
|---|---|---|
| `name_key` | `nameKey` | `Accessor<string \| number>` |
| `value_key` | `valueKey` | `Accessor<number \| null \| undefined>` |
| `cells` | `cells` | `number` |
| `columns` | `columns` | `number` |

```python
import reflex as rx
from reflex_silverpoint_react import waffle_chart


class State(rx.State):
    rows: list[dict] = []


def waffle_chart_view() -> rx.Component:
    return waffle_chart(data=State.rows, name_key="use", value_key="kwh", title="Waffle chart", id="waffle-chart")
```

The demo's first rows (read through name_key="use", value_key="kwh"), drawn when `data` is omitted:

```json
[{"use": "Heating", "kwh": 412}, {"use": "Water heating", "kwh": 263}, {"use": "Appliances", "kwh": 158}]
```

## squarified_treemap

`squarified-treemap` · `SquarifiedTreemap` · Nested rectangles, area by value, drillable through `rootId` and `onRootChange`.

Its own props (the common ones are in [SKILL.md](../../SKILL.md#common-chart-props)):

| Python | JS | Type |
|---|---|---|
| `id_key` | `idKey` | `Accessor<string>` |
| `parent_key` | `parentKey` | `Accessor<string \| null \| undefined>` |
| `label_key` | `labelKey` | `Accessor<string \| null \| undefined>` |
| `value_key` | `valueKey` | `Accessor<number \| null \| undefined>` |
| `depth` | `depth` | `number` |
| `root_id` | `rootId` | `string \| null` |
| `on_root_change` | `onRootChange` | `(id: string \| null) => void` |

```python
import reflex as rx
from reflex_silverpoint_react import squarified_treemap


class State(rx.State):
    rows: list[dict] = []


def squarified_treemap_view() -> rx.Component:
    return squarified_treemap(
        data=State.rows,
        id_key="id",
        parent_key="parent",
        label_key="name",
        value_key="amount",
        title="Squarified treemap",
        id="squarified-treemap",
    )
```

The demo's first rows (read through id_key="id", parent_key="parent", label_key="name", value_key="amount"), drawn when `data` is omitted:

